meta.title: Rumble
meta.description: A heart beats in the darkness, and inscribed upon it is sincerity.

units.rawText: Outer Oasis Plaza.
units.displayText: Outer Oasis Plaza.

units.displayText: ...ville?

units.rawText: Eh...
units.displayText: Eh...

spans.text: Eh...

units.rawText: Bonneville? Are you listening?
units.displayText: Bonneville? Are you listening?

spans.text: Bonneville? Are you listening?

units.rawText: Huh? Yeah, yeah I am... yawn~
units.displayText: Huh? Yeah, yeah I am... yawn~

spans.text: Huh? Yeah, yeah I am... yawn~

units.rawText: Bonneville stretches in the chilly night wind, absentmindedly fending off the person on the other side of the line.
units.displayText: Bonneville stretches in the chilly night wind, absentmindedly fending off the person on the other side of the line.

spans.text: Bonneville stretches in the chilly night wind, absentmindedly fending off the person on the other side of the line.

units.rawText: If the irksome obstacle known as work wasn't in the way, this would be a prime evening for a ride.
units.displayText: If the irksome obstacle known as work wasn't in the way, this would be a prime evening for a ride.

spans.text: If the irksome obstacle known as work wasn't in the way, this would be a prime evening for a ride.

units.rawText: "Man, I wanna go for a ride!" Is that what you're thinking right now?
units.displayText: "Man, I wanna go for a ride!" Is that what you're thinking right now?

spans.text: "Man, I wanna go for a ride!" Is that what you're thinking right now?

units.rawText: Oh? Could it be that our esteemed Lady Shale acquired the art of mind reading through the perusal of some dusty old tome?
units.displayText: Oh? Could it be that our esteemed Lady Shale acquired the art of mind reading through the perusal of some dusty old tome?

spans.text: Oh? Could it be that our esteemed Lady Shale acquired the art of mind reading through the perusal of some dusty old tome?

units.rawText: Anyone with eyes could see that your head's in the clouds! Seriously, I get that you're not interested in this assignment, but work is work! Take it seriously!
units.displayText: Anyone with eyes could see that your head's in the clouds! Seriously, I get that you're not interested in this assignment, but work is work! Take it seriously!

spans.text: Anyone with eyes could see that your head's in the clouds! Seriously, I get that you're not interested in this assignment, but work is work! Take it seriously!

units.rawText: But I am! Look, I've handed in my report today, haven't I?
units.displayText: But I am! Look, I've handed in my report today, haven't I?

spans.text: But I am! Look, I've handed in my report today, haven't I?

units.rawText: "Workin' on it"... that's all for your report? You didn't even add a period!
units.displayText: "Workin' on it"... that's all for your report? You didn't even add a period!

spans.text: "Workin' on it"... that's all for your report? You didn't even add a period!

units.rawText: I am working on it, and there haven't been any noteworthy developments...
units.displayText: I am working on it, and there haven't been any noteworthy developments...

spans.text: I am working on it, and there haven't been any noteworthy developments...

units.rawText: Gah... have you tried talking with the Professor, then?
units.displayText: Gah... have you tried talking with the Professor, then?

spans.text: Gah... have you tried talking with the Professor, then?

units.rawText: I did go looking for them, but...
units.displayText: I did go looking for them, but...

spans.text: I did go looking for them, but...

units.rawText: Excuse me, Professor...
units.displayText: Excuse me, Professor...

spans.text: Excuse me, Professor...

units.rawText: Prof, Prof, you gotta cover for me! Sis is after me again because she caught wind of me having instant noodles!
units.displayText: Prof, Prof, you gotta cover for me! Sis is after me again because she caught wind of me having instant noodles!

spans.text: Prof, Prof, you gotta cover for me! Sis is after me again because she caught wind of me having instant noodles!

units.rawText: Professor, Nanaka's working on a new song. If you could give me some feedback on it, Nanaka would be very happy...
units.displayText: Professor, Nanaka's working on a new song. If you could give me some feedback on it, Nanaka would be very happy...

spans.text: Professor, Nanaka's working on a new song. If you could give me some feedback on it, Nanaka would be very happy...

units.rawText: Professor, you promised me that you would go with me to the launch sale of that new and limited model kit! If we don't leave now, they'll run out!
units.displayText: Professor, you promised me that you would go with me to the launch sale of that new and limited model kit! If we don't leave now, they'll run out!

spans.text: Professor, you promised me that you would go with me to the launch sale of that new and limited model kit! If we don't leave now, they'll run out!

units.rawText: That's all well and good... but could you guys line up?
units.displayText: That's all well and good... but could you guys line up?

spans.text: That's all well and good... but could you guys line up?

units.rawText: They're popular to an unbelievable degree. They're surrounded each and every day by all of the Oasis' agents. I can't even get a foot in the door.
units.displayText: They're popular to an unbelievable degree. They're surrounded each and every day by all of the Oasis' agents. I can't even get a foot in the door.

spans.text: They're popular to an unbelievable degree. They're surrounded each and every day by all of the Oasis' agents. I can't even get a foot in the door.

units.rawText: There's no way that's not an excuse! I'm sure if you just waited a little bit, they'll be more than happy to speak with you.
units.displayText: There's no way that's not an excuse! I'm sure if you just waited a little bit, they'll be more than happy to speak with you.

spans.text: There's no way that's not an excuse! I'm sure if you just waited a little bit, they'll be more than happy to speak with you.

units.rawText: Well, if there's one thing I hate most it's waiting...
units.displayText: Well, if there's one thing I hate most it's waiting...

spans.text: Well, if there's one thing I hate most it's waiting...

units.rawText: Bonneville, do you still loathe interacting with humans that much?
units.displayText: Bonneville, do you still loathe interacting with humans that much?

spans.text: Bonneville, do you still loathe interacting with humans that much?

units.rawText: Sigh. I can turn a blind eye, but the Boss isn't as lenient as I am.
units.displayText: Sigh. I can turn a blind eye, but the Boss isn't as lenient as I am.

spans.text: Sigh. I can turn a blind eye, but the Boss isn't as lenient as I am.

units.rawText: If it slips out that this is your attitude while on an assignment, and that you head out in the middle of the night to just drive around...
units.displayText: If it slips out that this is your attitude while on an assignment, and that you head out in the middle of the night to just drive around...

spans.text: If it slips out that this is your attitude while on an assignment, and that you head out in the middle of the night to just drive around...

units.rawText: Ack! Please don't tell the Boss. Sangoma will absolutely embellish and blow it out of proportion, and I'll be hit with a bunch of restrictions.
units.displayText: Ack! Please don't tell the Boss. Sangoma will absolutely embellish and blow it out of proportion, and I'll be hit with a bunch of restrictions.

spans.text: Ack! Please don't tell the Boss. Sangoma will absolutely embellish and blow it out of proportion, and I'll be hit with a bunch of restrictions.

units.rawText: Oh great and generous Miss Shale, could you please perhaps not report this in exchange for a copy of Nora's new periodical?
units.displayText: Oh great and generous Miss Shale, could you please perhaps not report this in exchange for a copy of Nora's new periodical?

spans.text: Oh great and generous Miss Shale, could you please perhaps not report this in exchange for a copy of Nora's new periodical?

units.rawText: N-Nora's new...
units.displayText: N-Nora's new...

spans.text: N-Nora's new...

units.rawText: A little birdie told me it's a rarely seen romance piece, called something along the lines of "The Domineering Professor Is In Love With Me". Man, it was so popular that all of the pre-orders were gone in an instant. Thank goodness I got onto the list early...
units.displayText: A little birdie told me it's a rarely seen romance piece, called something along the lines of "The Domineering Professor Is In Love With Me". Man, it was so popular that all of the pre-orders were gone in an instant. Thank goodness I got onto the list early...

spans.text: A little birdie told me it's a rarely seen romance piece, called something along the lines of "The Domineering Professor Is In Love With Me". Man, it was so popular that all of the pre-orders were gone in an instant. Thank goodness I got onto the list early...

units.rawText: <size=40>Deal!</size>
units.displayText: Deal!

spans.text: Deal!

units.rawText: Getting a grip before she forgets herself, Shale turns around quickly, clearing her throat.
units.displayText: Getting a grip before she forgets herself, Shale turns around quickly, clearing her throat.

spans.text: Getting a grip before she forgets herself, Shale turns around quickly, clearing her throat.

units.rawText: Ahem, I can help you keep that quiet, but you have to take your work seriously! I've bailed you out on the reports three days in a row now. If tomorrow's the same, I can't make any guarantees, alright?
units.displayText: Ahem, I can help you keep that quiet, but you have to take your work seriously! I've bailed you out on the reports three days in a row now. If tomorrow's the same, I can't make any guarantees, alright?

spans.text: Ahem, I can help you keep that quiet, but you have to take your work seriously! I've bailed you out on the reports three days in a row now. If tomorrow's the same, I can't make any guarantees, alright?

units.rawText: Got it! Don't worry, the Guardians' catchphrase is always in my heart—"For Arcadia!"
units.displayText: Got it! Don't worry, the Guardians' catchphrase is always in my heart—"For Arcadia!"

spans.text: Got it! Don't worry, the Guardians' catchphrase is always in my heart—"For Arcadia!"

units.rawText: Alright, if you say so... Nora's new publication! Don't you forget!
units.displayText: Alright, if you say so... Nora's new publication! Don't you forget!

spans.text: Alright, if you say so... Nora's new publication! Don't you forget!

units.rawText: I won't, I won't.
units.displayText: I won't, I won't.

spans.text: I won't, I won't.

units.rawText: Shale nods, moving to end the call. She suddenly thinks of something and pauses.
units.displayText: Shale nods, moving to end the call. She suddenly thinks of something and pauses.

spans.text: Shale nods, moving to end the call. She suddenly thinks of something and pauses.

units.rawText: Oh right, I know you won't listen to me if I asked you to stop speeding around like you do... but at least be careful.
units.displayText: Oh right, I know you won't listen to me if I asked you to stop speeding around like you do... but at least be careful.

spans.text: Oh right, I know you won't listen to me if I asked you to stop speeding around like you do... but at least be careful.

units.rawText: ...Appreciate it, Missy. Don't you worry.
units.displayText: ...Appreciate it, Missy. Don't you worry.

spans.text: ...Appreciate it, Missy. Don't you worry.

units.rawText: Before Shale can launch into a lengthy, disgruntled tirade, Bonneville ends the call. Leaning against her beloved bike, she gently squeezes the rubber duck perched on its handlebars.
units.displayText: Before Shale can launch into a lengthy, disgruntled tirade, Bonneville ends the call. Leaning against her beloved bike, she gently squeezes the rubber duck perched on its handlebars.

spans.text: Before Shale can launch into a lengthy, disgruntled tirade, Bonneville ends the call. Leaning against her beloved bike, she gently squeezes the rubber duck perched on its handlebars.

units.rawText: Looks like no more slacking, huh... Let me think, how should I deal with the report that's due tomorrow?
units.displayText: Looks like no more slacking, huh... Let me think, how should I deal with the report that's due tomorrow?

spans.text: Looks like no more slacking, huh... Let me think, how should I deal with the report that's due tomorrow?

units.rawText: Man, what was the Boss thinking, sending me on an assignment like this knowing that I'm no good at them...
units.displayText: Man, what was the Boss thinking, sending me on an assignment like this knowing that I'm no good at them...

spans.text: Man, what was the Boss thinking, sending me on an assignment like this knowing that I'm no good at them...

units.rawText: ...But I'm sure the Boss has her own reasons. Maybe she even saw my complaints coming.
units.displayText: ...But I'm sure the Boss has her own reasons. Maybe she even saw my complaints coming.

spans.text: ...But I'm sure the Boss has her own reasons. Maybe she even saw my complaints coming.

units.rawText: Bonneville sighs, looking into the cloudless night horizon. Resting her weight on her motorcycle, the stars seem to urge her to leave the hardships of work behind.
units.displayText: Bonneville sighs, looking into the cloudless night horizon. Resting her weight on her motorcycle, the stars seem to urge her to leave the hardships of work behind.

spans.text: Bonneville sighs, looking into the cloudless night horizon. Resting her weight on her motorcycle, the stars seem to urge her to leave the hardships of work behind.

units.rawText: —So, surely it isn't unreasonable for me to go for another two laps, right? I'm sure the Boss won't mind.
units.displayText: —So, surely it isn't unreasonable for me to go for another two laps, right? I'm sure the Boss won't mind.

spans.text: —So, surely it isn't unreasonable for me to go for another two laps, right? I'm sure the Boss won't mind.

units.rawText: Bonneville mounts her motorcycle, revving up the engine. Its mechanical clamor shatters the stillness of the night, but Bonneville's agitated heart quiets down as the air begins to boil.
units.displayText: Bonneville mounts her motorcycle, revving up the engine. Its mechanical clamor shatters the stillness of the night, but Bonneville's agitated heart quiets down as the air begins to boil.

spans.text: Bonneville mounts her motorcycle, revving up the engine. Its mechanical clamor shatters the stillness of the night, but Bonneville's agitated heart quiets down as the air begins to boil.

units.rawText: As she wrangles the throttle and brings horsepower to yield, even the mellow evening wind becomes bone-chilling. A foreign road ahead to traverse all by her lonesome, with not a worry in the world.
units.displayText: As she wrangles the throttle and brings horsepower to yield, even the mellow evening wind becomes bone-chilling. A foreign road ahead to traverse all by her lonesome, with not a worry in the world.

spans.text: As she wrangles the throttle and brings horsepower to yield, even the mellow evening wind becomes bone-chilling. A foreign road ahead to traverse all by her lonesome, with not a worry in the world.

units.rawText: (Faster... just a little faster...)
units.displayText: Faster... just a little faster...

spans.text: Faster... just a little faster...

units.rawText: (If only I could just keep accelerating like this...)
units.displayText: If only I could just keep accelerating like this...

spans.text: If only I could just keep accelerating like this...

units.rawText: A supersonic figure returns to the Oasis Square. With a stylish spinning half-donut, Bonneville comes to a stop.
units.displayText: A supersonic figure returns to the Oasis Square. With a stylish spinning half-donut, Bonneville comes to a stop.

spans.text: A supersonic figure returns to the Oasis Square. With a stylish spinning half-donut, Bonneville comes to a stop.

units.rawText: Safe and sound—hm, I should feel satisfied now, but it just feels hollow. Weird.
units.displayText: Safe and sound—hm, I should feel satisfied now, but it just feels hollow. Weird.

spans.text: Safe and sound—hm, I should feel satisfied now, but it just feels hollow. Weird.

units.rawText: Well, let's leave it at that for today, it'll probably be dawn soon... huh?
units.displayText: Well, let's leave it at that for today, it'll probably be dawn soon... huh?

spans.text: Well, let's leave it at that for today, it'll probably be dawn soon... huh?

units.rawText: Someone's still awake here at the Oasis at this hour?
units.displayText: Someone's still awake here at the Oasis at this hour?

spans.text: Someone's still awake here at the Oasis at this hour?

units.rawText: Bonneville silences her bike's engine, surreptitiously looking towards the light from a back alley.
units.displayText: Bonneville silences her bike's engine, surreptitiously looking towards the light from a back alley.

spans.text: Bonneville silences her bike's engine, surreptitiously looking towards the light from a back alley.

units.rawText: "Choco's Chocolaterie"... sounds like a sweets shop. Let's see who might be inside...
units.displayText: "Choco's Chocolaterie"... sounds like a sweets shop. Let's see who might be inside...

spans.text: "Choco's Chocolaterie"... sounds like a sweets shop. Let's see who might be inside...

units.rawText: <size=40>...Professor?</size>
units.displayText: ...Professor?

spans.text: ...Professor?

units.rawText: Only one-third of the chocolates are left to package... I see the light at the end of the tunnel!
units.displayText: Only one-third of the chocolates are left to package... I see the light at the end of the tunnel!

spans.text: Only one-third of the chocolates are left to package... I see the light at the end of the tunnel!

units.rawText: There should be some time still until sunrise, I should rest a little... no, not just yet! I'll have to arrange tomorrow's timetable too, let's see...
units.displayText: There should be some time still until sunrise, I should rest a little... no, not just yet! I'll have to arrange tomorrow's timetable too, let's see...

spans.text: There should be some time still until sunrise, I should rest a little... no, not just yet! I'll have to arrange tomorrow's timetable too, let's see...

units.rawText: I've got Angela at seven, then Turing, Nascita... Ah, Antonina's not said anything, but it's best to put aside some time...
units.displayText: I've got Angela at seven, then Turing, Nascita... Ah, Antonina's not said anything, but it's best to put aside some time...

spans.text: I've got Angela at seven, then Turing, Nascita... Ah, Antonina's not said anything, but it's best to put aside some time...

units.rawText: ...Why are there only 24 hours in a day?
units.displayText: ...Why are there only 24 hours in a day?

spans.text: ...Why are there only 24 hours in a day?

units.rawText: I sit down at the table, offhandedly grabbing a cup of water, trying to fend off the swelling drowsiness with the frigidity of cold water.
units.displayText: I sit down at the table, offhandedly grabbing a cup of water, trying to fend off the swelling drowsiness with the frigidity of cold water.

spans.text: I sit down at the table, offhandedly grabbing a cup of water, trying to fend off the swelling drowsiness with the frigidity of cold water.

units.rawText: ...Professor? What are you doing?
units.displayText: ...Professor? What are you doing?

spans.text: ...Professor? What are you doing?

units.rawText: <size=40>Phhht—cough cough!</size>
units.displayText: Phhht—cough cough!

spans.text: Phhht—cough cough!

units.rawText: N-Nothing, I swear! I'm just out for a stroll because I couldn't sleep!
units.displayText: N-Nothing, I swear! I'm just out for a stroll because I couldn't sleep!

spans.text: N-Nothing, I swear! I'm just out for a stroll because I couldn't sleep!

units.rawText: Then these chocolates...
units.displayText: Then these chocolates...

spans.text: Then these chocolates...

units.rawText: Oh don't worry, I prepared these chocolates long ago. I'm not rushing them at the last moment or anything...
units.displayText: Oh don't worry, I prepared these chocolates long ago. I'm not rushing them at the last moment or anything...

spans.text: Oh don't worry, I prepared these chocolates long ago. I'm not rushing them at the last moment or anything...

units.rawText: I try to block the unfinished confectionaries behind me with my body. I turn around to be met by a golden pair of eyes, brimming with mirth.
units.displayText: I try to block the unfinished confectionaries behind me with my body. I turn around to be met by a golden pair of eyes, brimming with mirth.

spans.text: I try to block the unfinished confectionaries behind me with my body. I turn around to be met by a golden pair of eyes, brimming with mirth.

units.rawText: Pfft... Ahahaha, this is the first time I've ever seen you this startled, Professor!
units.displayText: Pfft... Ahahaha, this is the first time I've ever seen you this startled, Professor!

spans.text: Pfft... Ahahaha, this is the first time I've ever seen you this startled, Professor!

units.rawText: Seriously... It was you, Bonneville. You really gave me a scare.
units.displayText: Seriously... It was you, Bonneville. You really gave me a scare.

spans.text: Seriously... It was you, Bonneville. You really gave me a scare.

units.rawText: Seeing who it was, I let out a breath, wiping away the water on my face.
units.displayText: Seeing who it was, I let out a breath, wiping away the water on my face.

spans.text: Seeing who it was, I let out a breath, wiping away the water on my face.

units.rawText: So, who'd you think I was?
units.displayText: So, who'd you think I was?

spans.text: So, who'd you think I was?

units.rawText: I'm struggling to think of any good options...
units.displayText: I'm struggling to think of any good options...

spans.text: I'm struggling to think of any good options...

units.rawText: You sure that I'm not someone you don't want to see? Let me guess... You've been up all night preparing chocolates for White Day return gifts?
units.displayText: You sure that I'm not someone you don't want to see? Let me guess... You've been up all night preparing chocolates for White Day return gifts?

spans.text: You sure that I'm not someone you don't want to see? Let me guess... You've been up all night preparing chocolates for White Day return gifts?

units.rawText: Y-You got me...
units.displayText: Y-You got me...

spans.text: Y-You got me...

units.rawText: If I were to send a photo of this to Persicaria...
units.displayText: If I were to send a photo of this to Persicaria...

spans.text: If I were to send a photo of this to Persicaria...

units.rawText: ...Hahaha, come on now, I'm only joking.
units.displayText: ...Hahaha, come on now, I'm only joking.

spans.text: ...Hahaha, come on now, I'm only joking.

units.rawText: Bonneville gives me a pat on the shoulder, approaching the chocolates behind me with great interest. She picks one up, contemplating it.
units.displayText: Bonneville gives me a pat on the shoulder, approaching the chocolates behind me with great interest. She picks one up, contemplating it.

spans.text: Bonneville gives me a pat on the shoulder, approaching the chocolates behind me with great interest. She picks one up, contemplating it.

units.rawText: This portion is for Hubble, this is for Undine... And there's Lind's, Hatsuchiri's, Sueyoi's... You even set aside a portion for the Guardians.
units.displayText: This portion is for Hubble, this is for Undine... And there's Lind's, Hatsuchiri's, Sueyoi's... You even set aside a portion for the Guardians.

spans.text: This portion is for Hubble, this is for Undine... And there's Lind's, Hatsuchiri's, Sueyoi's... You even set aside a portion for the Guardians.

units.rawText: And all of these... are custom-made for their intended recipient?
units.displayText: And all of these... are custom-made for their intended recipient?

spans.text: And all of these... are custom-made for their intended recipient?

units.rawText: Of course. Everyone gives out their chocolates with nothing but their most sincere wishes. How could I respond to that half-heartedly?
units.displayText: Of course. Everyone gives out their chocolates with nothing but their most sincere wishes. How could I respond to that half-heartedly?

spans.text: Of course. Everyone gives out their chocolates with nothing but their most sincere wishes. How could I respond to that half-heartedly?

units.rawText: It's just that inspiration often shows up in the process of making these, and the amount of work to be done just kept increasing...
units.displayText: It's just that inspiration often shows up in the process of making these, and the amount of work to be done just kept increasing...

spans.text: It's just that inspiration often shows up in the process of making these, and the amount of work to be done just kept increasing...

units.rawText: Ah, right, since you're here already...
units.displayText: Ah, right, since you're here already...

spans.text: Ah, right, since you're here already...

units.rawText: As Bonneville looks at me in surprise, I dig through a pile of gift boxes, retrieving a red box bound with a golden ribbon.
units.displayText: As Bonneville looks at me in surprise, I dig through a pile of gift boxes, retrieving a red box bound with a golden ribbon.

spans.text: As Bonneville looks at me in surprise, I dig through a pile of gift boxes, retrieving a red box bound with a golden ribbon.

units.rawText: This is for you, Bonneville. Happy White Day.
units.displayText: This is for you, Bonneville. Happy White Day.

spans.text: This is for you, Bonneville. Happy White Day.

units.rawText: For me?
units.displayText: For me?

spans.text: For me?

units.rawText: You've not been at the Oasis for long, and I haven't been able to pin down what your preferences are... I hope you like it.
units.displayText: You've not been at the Oasis for long, and I haven't been able to pin down what your preferences are... I hope you like it.

spans.text: You've not been at the Oasis for long, and I haven't been able to pin down what your preferences are... I hope you like it.

units.rawText: Bonneville looks at the box, recognizing that the forcefully inscribed lettering on it was indeed her name. She freezes on the spot for a moment.
units.displayText: Bonneville looks at the box, recognizing that the forcefully inscribed lettering on it was indeed her name. She freezes on the spot for a moment.

spans.text: Bonneville looks at the box, recognizing that the forcefully inscribed lettering on it was indeed her name. She freezes on the spot for a moment.

units.rawText: I... did not see this coming.
units.displayText: I... did not see this coming.

spans.text: I... did not see this coming.

units.rawText: I thought that the Oasis' leader was another walking bore of a human, but... I think I'm beginning to get why you're so popular.
units.displayText: I thought that the Oasis' leader was another walking bore of a human, but... I think I'm beginning to get why you're so popular.

spans.text: I thought that the Oasis' leader was another walking bore of a human, but... I think I'm beginning to get why you're so popular.

units.rawText: She takes the box, giving me a brilliant smile.
units.displayText: She takes the box, giving me a brilliant smile.

spans.text: She takes the box, giving me a brilliant smile.

units.rawText: Thank you, Professor. This is the first time I've ever received chocolates on Valentine's. I'll treasure this.
units.displayText: Thank you, Professor. This is the first time I've ever received chocolates on Valentine's. I'll treasure this.

spans.text: Thank you, Professor. This is the first time I've ever received chocolates on Valentine's. I'll treasure this.

units.rawText: I would be happier if you enjoyed the chocolates rather than treasuring the packaging.
units.displayText: I would be happier if you enjoyed the chocolates rather than treasuring the packaging.

spans.text: I would be happier if you enjoyed the chocolates rather than treasuring the packaging.

units.rawText: I'm conflicted. How could I just take apart this lovely packaging?
units.displayText: I'm conflicted. How could I just take apart this lovely packaging?

spans.text: I'm conflicted. How could I just take apart this lovely packaging?

units.rawText: Bonneville beams at the myriad of chocolates in front of her, blinking at me.
units.displayText: Bonneville beams at the myriad of chocolates in front of her, blinking at me.

spans.text: Bonneville beams at the myriad of chocolates in front of her, blinking at me.

units.rawText: Well, I see there are still some unpackaged chocolates. Could it be that you're not done yet, Professor?
units.displayText: Well, I see there are still some unpackaged chocolates. Could it be that you're not done yet, Professor?

spans.text: Well, I see there are still some unpackaged chocolates. Could it be that you're not done yet, Professor?

units.rawText: Ugh...
units.displayText: Ugh...

spans.text: Ugh...

units.rawText: As reality hits me again, I feel an oncoming migraine.
units.displayText: As reality hits me again, I feel an oncoming migraine.

spans.text: As reality hits me again, I feel an oncoming migraine.

units.rawText: About a third left...
units.displayText: About a third left...

spans.text: About a third left...

units.rawText: There are about 4 hours until sunrise, I think? If you don't hurry up, the other Dolls will find out.
units.displayText: There are about 4 hours until sunrise, I think? If you don't hurry up, the other Dolls will find out.

spans.text: There are about 4 hours until sunrise, I think? If you don't hurry up, the other Dolls will find out.

units.rawText: I suppose there is the risk of that... I should use what time I have.
units.displayText: I suppose there is the risk of that... I should use what time I have.

spans.text: I suppose there is the risk of that... I should use what time I have.

units.rawText: I begin to stand up, but darkness threatens to overtake me, and the only thing that stops me from falling is the table in front of me.
units.displayText: I begin to stand up, but darkness threatens to overtake me, and the only thing that stops me from falling is the table in front of me.

spans.text: I begin to stand up, but darkness threatens to overtake me, and the only thing that stops me from falling is the table in front of me.

units.rawText: Hey! You alright?
units.displayText: Hey! You alright?

spans.text: Hey! You alright?

units.rawText: Gah... I'm alright, just a bit dizzy. I'll be fine in a bit.
units.displayText: Gah... I'm alright, just a bit dizzy. I'll be fine in a bit.

spans.text: Gah... I'm alright, just a bit dizzy. I'll be fine in a bit.

units.rawText: ...How long has it been since you rested? You've at least slept in the past few days, right?
units.displayText: ...How long has it been since you rested? You've at least slept in the past few days, right?

spans.text: ...How long has it been since you rested? You've at least slept in the past few days, right?

units.rawText: Yeah, just not a whole lot. One or two hours a day at most.
units.displayText: Yeah, just not a whole lot. One or two hours a day at most.

spans.text: Yeah, just not a whole lot. One or two hours a day at most.

units.rawText: Woah, work is this intense at the Oasis?
units.displayText: Woah, work is this intense at the Oasis?

spans.text: Woah, work is this intense at the Oasis?

units.rawText: I usually get a full 6 hours, but with the return gifts on top of daily work, I can only take time out of rest to make chocolates...
units.displayText: I usually get a full 6 hours, but with the return gifts on top of daily work, I can only take time out of rest to make chocolates...

spans.text: I usually get a full 6 hours, but with the return gifts on top of daily work, I can only take time out of rest to make chocolates...

units.rawText: You really are pushing it. Sigh... guess it can't be helped.
units.displayText: You really are pushing it. Sigh... guess it can't be helped.

spans.text: You really are pushing it. Sigh... guess it can't be helped.

units.rawText: Bonneville grips my shoulders, pressing me back into my chair.
units.displayText: Bonneville grips my shoulders, pressing me back into my chair.

spans.text: Bonneville grips my shoulders, pressing me back into my chair.

units.rawText: You go rest for a bit. I'll do the rest for you.
units.displayText: You go rest for a bit. I'll do the rest for you.

spans.text: You go rest for a bit. I'll do the rest for you.

units.rawText: Eh?
units.displayText: Eh?

spans.text: Eh?

units.rawText: This isn't my line of work, but it's not like I can't do meticulous work. Just tell me what to do.
units.displayText: This isn't my line of work, but it's not like I can't do meticulous work. Just tell me what to do.

spans.text: This isn't my line of work, but it's not like I can't do meticulous work. Just tell me what to do.

units.rawText: It'll be done faster this way, no? If it goes smoothly, you might even be able to sleep for a little.
units.displayText: It'll be done faster this way, no? If it goes smoothly, you might even be able to sleep for a little.

spans.text: It'll be done faster this way, no? If it goes smoothly, you might even be able to sleep for a little.

units.rawText: You only got here recently, but here I am, making you stay up late to help me with chocolates. What an embarrassment.
units.displayText: You only got here recently, but here I am, making you stay up late to help me with chocolates. What an embarrassment.

spans.text: You only got here recently, but here I am, making you stay up late to help me with chocolates. What an embarrassment.

units.rawText: No need for the pleasantries. You'll need to rest while you can to meet with everyone tomorrow, right? Your time is precious, after all.
units.displayText: No need for the pleasantries. You'll need to rest while you can to meet with everyone tomorrow, right? Your time is precious, after all.

spans.text: No need for the pleasantries. You'll need to rest while you can to meet with everyone tomorrow, right? Your time is precious, after all.

units.rawText: So you heard that bit too...
units.displayText: So you heard that bit too...

spans.text: So you heard that bit too...

units.rawText: I took your chocolates, after all. I'll lend you this pair of hands for now as repayment.
units.displayText: I took your chocolates, after all. I'll lend you this pair of hands for now as repayment.

spans.text: I took your chocolates, after all. I'll lend you this pair of hands for now as repayment.

units.rawText: Let's see... This portion is for Rise. Tell me, what should I do?
units.displayText: Let's see... This portion is for Rise. Tell me, what should I do?

spans.text: Let's see... This portion is for Rise. Tell me, what should I do?

units.rawText: Her tone demands a response, but instills a sense of security.
units.displayText: Her tone demands a response, but instills a sense of security.

spans.text: Her tone demands a response, but instills a sense of security.

units.rawText: ...Go for the packaging paper with the movie poster print. Yeah, that one.
units.displayText: ...Go for the packaging paper with the movie poster print. Yeah, that one.

spans.text: ...Go for the packaging paper with the movie poster print. Yeah, that one.

units.rawText: Thank you, Bonneville.
units.displayText: Thank you, Bonneville.

spans.text: Thank you, Bonneville.
